fact: AICCRA reports that, with the Ministry of Agriculture, the Institut d'Economie Rurale and Mali-Meteo, it extended RIICE satellite rice monitoring to major irrigated and rainfed rice zones and prepared institutional frameworks to operate the tool within national agricultural monitoring systems.
system: RIICE (Remote Sensing-based Information and Insurance for Crops in Emerging Economies)

fact: IWMI states that the Mali Drought Monitoring System, built on WaPOR satellite data and co-developed with the Ministry of Agriculture's National Directorate of Agriculture, is in beta under stakeholder review, to be hosted by CPS/SDR and operated by the directorate once validated.
IWMI, with Mali's Direction Nationale de l'Agriculture and FAO, held a workshop on 21 March 2024 in Bamako to co-develop an agricultural drought monitoring platform using WaPOR remote sensing data.
